note: A demo week for an intermediate guitarist: four practice days of about 30 minutes, built so no two days look alike. Each day opens with a short technique warm-up and ends in music: a solo, a slow blues, a song from a chart, three strums in one song. Between them sit sus chords, two positions joined on a position neck, bends, 3rds and 6ths on the double-stops neck, the E shape on the CAGED neck, and from theory a clap-along and a chord-change game. Day 4 holds the mix exercise for strumming.

plan.title: Week 1: two positions joined, bends and a song
plan.summary: Four practice days of about 30 minutes. Day 1 joins the first two positions of the minor pentatonic scale and solos across the join. Day 2 is bends that reach the note, then a slow blues. Day 3 plays 3rds and 6ths up the neck, names a chord change by ear and plays a song from a chart. Day 4 moves the E chord shape up the neck and puts three strumming patterns into one song.
plan.progress:
Techniques: hammer-ons and pull-offs in stages, then with fingers 2 and 4; down-up picking in stages; the finger order 1, 3, 2, 4; bends matched to the note two frets up. Next: a slide into a note and a bend out of it.
Extended chords: D, Dsus2 and Dsus4; Cadd9, G, Dsus4 and Em. Next: the sus groove in D.
Scales: the first two positions of the minor pentatonic scale joined with a slide, a solo across the join, a slow blues with one bend a phrase, notes named up the neck. Next: position 3.
CAGED: the 3rds and 6ths of one key up to fret 12; the E shape as a barre chord. Next: the A shape.
Basic chords: a verse and a chorus with G, Em, C and D from a chart; three strumming patterns in one song. Next: a song with a bridge.
Basics: sixteenths tapped on the lane. Next: quarters to sixteenths mixed.
Ear: names the second chord as the 4 or the 5. Next: the 6th chord among them.

days.theme: 3rds and 6ths, a chord change by ear and a song
The E shape up the neck, and three strums in one song
